item.title: 14K Seattle Public Schools students skipped class during Super Bowl parade
item.description: According to Seattle Public Schools, 14,481 students recorded full-day absences during Wednesday’s Super Bowl parade, a figure roughly three times higher than a typical school day.

item.title: Five arrested in WA drug trafficking operation, suspected of selling to minors
item.description: Five people were arrested in Thurston County after investigators uncovered an armed drug trafficking operation allegedly selling to minors as young as 13.

item.title: Seattle weather: Soggy, murky in Seattle on Friday
item.description: Rain returns to Western Washington on Friday, and it’s looking especially soggy and sloppy into the afternoon hours, so plan for a damp commute and steady showers at times.

item.title: King County Executive takes action to limit ICE operations at World Cup
item.description: King County Executive Girmay Zahilay said his office is taking immediate action to protect immigrants and refugees from federal immigration enforcement operations.

item.title: Seattle councilmember moves to restrict ICE information sharing
item.description: A Seattle City Councilmember has introduced a bill to bar city employees from sharing non-public information for civil immigration enforcement without a judicial warrant.

item.title: Sound Transit says Super Bowl parade a ‘stress test’ for World Cup 2026
item.description: Sound Transit says the region’s light rail system passed a major stress test during the Seahawks’ Super Bowl victory parade, and will inform their planning for the World Cup this summer.

item.title: Police shooting investigation underway in Seattle's Ballard neighborhood
item.description: Authorities are investigating a shooting involving a police officer in Seattle's Ballard neighborhood late Thursday afternoon.

item.title: Seven Seahawks including Sam Darnold, Cooper Kupp have contract options due Friday
item.description: A handful of key contributors for the Seattle Seahawks have bonuses in their contracts that are set to kick in on Friday, guaranteeing bonuses or base salary for the 2026 season.

item.title: University of Washington identifies 8 new bee species in Washington
item.description: A UW research scientist discovered eight bee species never before recorded in Washington state while studying pollinators in Chelan County.

item.title: Man shot, injured in Seattle's Columbia City neighborhood
item.description: A 33-year-old man was shot in Seattle's Columbia City neighborhood Thursday night.
